name: ctao_mst_11p5m
label: CTAO MST 11.5 m (NectarCAM)
sources: Biteau & Luce 2024-09-13, 'Stellar Intensity Interferometry with NectarCAM on the MSTs-N', CTA-N table (slides 18, 23): effective mirror area 88 m^2 including shadowing; optical efficiency at 420 nm 0.73; modified Davies-Cotton, f = 16 m, cone half angle 20 deg, arrival-time spread 0.7 ns rms from the dish shape
notes: The 0.7 ns rms dish-shape spread is below the Stage I electronic bandwidth (1/400 MHz = 2.5 ns) and is not modelled separately.
